question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is 'their'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given blank needs a **possessive **pronoun to refer to the fact that the donkey belonged to the man and his son.
 
• The correct pronoun in such a case is their which is used to refer to** belonging to or associated with the people or things previously mentioned or easily identified.**
 
• Hence, option 4 or their is the most appropriate option to **fill in blank number 2.**

Correct passage__ - *Once, a man and his son were going into town. (1) __they__ wanted to sell some potatoes. They went with (2) __their__ donkey, and the donkey (3) __carried__ the potatoes. While they walked, (4)__ a__ man came past on a horse.*

*"Shame (5) __on__ you!" he said. "Why do you have a donkey, but you don't ride it?"*
